s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly enlarging, firm, painless mass in the left labia majora with a history of recurrences
salient_findings: A slowly enlarging mass in the left labia majora over 10 years
The mass was firm, painless, immobile, and measured approximately 7 × 4 cm
History of recurrences after previous excisions
key_facts: The mass has been slowly enlarging over 10 years
The mass is firm, painless, and immobile
The patient has a history of previous excisions of masses in the Bartholin’s gland and labia majora
Histopathology has shown chondroid syringoma and clear cell hidradenoma
Imaging has revealed a heterogeneous, hypervascular subcutaneous mass
A low-density focus in the liver was suggestive of a simple cyst
The patient has experienced recurrences after previous excisions

raw.rationale: The patient's histopathology has consistently shown chondroid syringoma, and the mass's characteristics, such as being firm, painless, and immobile, are consistent with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Clear cell hidradenoma
rejected.why: Although histology showed clear cell hidradenoma in one instance, the majority of histopathology results indicated chondroid syringoma.

rejected.label: Aggressive angiomyxoma
rejected.why: There is no indication of aggressive behavior or angiomyxoma characteristics in the patient's history or histopathology results.

rejected.label: Vulvar adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: The patient's histopathology results do not indicate adenocarcinoma, and the mass's characteristics do not suggest a malignant process.

rejected.label: Bartholin gland carcinoma
rejected.why: The patient's history of masses in the Bartholin's gland and labia majora, as well as the histopathology results, do not suggest carcinoma of the Bartholin gland.
